messages.content:
ある質問が、次の候補のうちどれについて尋ねているかを判定してください。

質問: Grafana のソースコード（テストを除く）において、ヘルスチェック失敗時にリポジトリ自体の到達可能性と認証情報の有効性を判定する関数を直接呼び出している関数、およびそれらを直接呼び出している関数（2 段まで）をすべて挙げよ。

候補:
A. refreshHealth performs a comprehensive health check Returns test results, health status, and any error
B. splitItems separates a sorted list into folder items and non-folder items, preserving the order within each group.
C. processHooks handles hook execution with intelligent retry logic. `suppressed` reports whether there was hook work to do (generation changed or webhook missing) that got skipped this pass due to cooldown/repo inaccessibility, as opposed to there being genuinely nothing to do — the caller uses this t
D. isRepositoryAccessible reports whether a failed health check still means the repository itself is reachable and its credentials are valid -- i.e. the failure is a config/permission gap on an otherwise-usable repository, not a loss of access to the git server.
E. Run starts the RepositoryController.
F. processResourceItems processes non-folder items concurrently.
G. resolveQuotaStatus retrieves current quota limits, falling back to the cached status for observed repositories when the lookup fails. New repositories return the lookup error because they do not have a known valid cached quota.
H. deleteExistingItems removes all resources managed by the repository. Non-folder resources are deleted concurrently first, then folders are deleted sequentially deepest-first so they are empty before removal.

- 質問の内容に最も合う候補の記号を choice に書く。
- 二つ以上の候補が同じくらい当てはまり、質問だけではどれか決められないときは ambiguous を true にする。
- reason に判断の理由を短く書く。
JSON で答えてください。
